# Post 0.2.9
- Original email formatting is preserved by default, including sender fonts, signatures, body colors and image dimensions. - Reading settings offer independent custom font and app-color overrides. - Shift+Arrow selection releases list focus to prevent macOS error sounds. - Automatic sorting learns consistent sender destinations even when newsletter subjects change. - Includes the recent label menu, Sent recipient display, All Mail, and newsletter loading fixes.

# Post 0.2.8
- Embedded logos and images load more reliably, including older cached messages. - Pasted text matches your composer font instead of importing a different font.

Post 0.2.7
- Fixed unread messages being hidden because Post reused stale cached labels. When a Gmail query conflicts with the cached Inbox or Unread state, Post fetches current label metadata while keeping the downloaded body. - Apply explicit Inbox and Unread label constraints to both Gmail lists and counts. - Exclude Spam and Trash from Primary’s server query, matching its message list.
